fields.label: Free Trial (days)
fields.description: New parent accounts get full access for this many days.

fields.label: AI Messages per Learner per Day on Trial
Free lessons per learning area
fields.description: Without a trial or plan, a learner can still open this many lessons in each learning area (the first ones, in curriculum order), with their quizzes. Lessons ticked Is Free are free as well. 0 leaves only those.

fields.label: Learners can ask for missing lessons
fields.description: When a learner opens a sub-strand nobody has written a lesson for, they can ask for it: the AI writes it from the KICD outcomes and it is published at once, for every learner in that grade. Up to 5 a day per learner.

fields.label: App Session Length (days)
fields.description: How long a device stays signed in without being used.

fields.label: Learner Login Domain
fields.description: Learners have no email of their own. Their sign-in is stored as learner-CODE@this-domain. Use a domain you control, or leave the .invalid default so nothing is ever sent.

fields.label: Provider
fields.options:
OpenAI
Anthropic
Google Gemini
OpenAI Compatible
Cursor
fields.description: Cursor uses an API key from cursor.com/dashboard and is billed to your Cursor plan.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: For Cursor, a model id from your Cursor plan, for example composer-2.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Only for OpenAI Compatible (OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, Azure-style gateways). Example: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

fields.label: Extra Tutor Instructions
fields.description: Added to the tutor's instructions for every learner.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: From a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Web application.

fields.label: Redirect URL
fields.description: Add this exact address as an authorised redirect URI on the Google client.

fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: One host serves sandbox and live. A _test_ secret key runs in sandbox, a _live_ key in live.

fields.label: Webhook Challenge
fields.description: The challenge string set on the IntaSend webhook. Webhooks without it are ignored.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Set this as the collection_event webhook endpoint in IntaSend.

fields.label: Webhook ID
fields.description: From the PayPal app's webhook. Used to verify each webhook's signature.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: PayPal does not settle in KES, so plans carry a separate PayPal price.

fields.label: Reuse earlier answers
fields.description: A first question already answered for the same grade and lesson gets that answer again, with no AI call and no use of the learner's daily limit. Practice questions are shared the same way.

fields.label: Reuse answers for (days)
fields.description: Older answers are asked again, so a lesson that changed gets a fresh answer.

fields.label: Lessons written per day
fields.description: Each day, write lessons and quizzes for this many sub-strands that have none. One AI call per lesson, then every learner reads it for free. 0 is off.

fields.label: Publish written lessons straight away
fields.description: Off: written lessons wait as drafts for a teacher to check and publish. On: learners see them at once.

fields.label: Backup AI provider
fields.description: Answers when the main provider is down, rejects its key or is out of quota. Leave empty for none.

fields.label: Backup Provider
fields.options:
OpenAI
